project_type: .NET 10 ASP.NET Core backend (CQRS/MediatR, EF Core 10, PostgreSQL via Npgsql) + Angular 19 standalone-component SSR frontend
build_system: dotnet (backend, single project at backend/ranker/ranker.csproj); Angular CLI ng build (frontend at ranker.ui/)
test_framework: No test projects detected in the repo. Verification is done via dotnet build and ng build --configuration production.
build_command: dotnet build backend/ranker/ranker.csproj  (backend);  cd ranker.ui && ng build --configuration production  (frontend)
test_command: dotnet build backend/ranker/ranker.csproj && cd ranker.ui && ng build --configuration production
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'dotnet build backend/ranker/ranker.csproj' from the repo root — must exit 0 with no errors. 2) Run 'cd ranker.ui && ng build --configuration production' — must exit 0. 3) Confirm migration file exists under backend/ranker/Migrations/. 4) Confirm my-transactions chunk appears in Angular build output.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/ranker/Migrations/RankerDbContextModelSnapshot.cs is regenerated by 'dotnet ef migrations add ...' — do not edit manually.
environment_constraints: EF migrations must be run from backend/ranker/ directory (where ranker.csproj lives). Angular build must be run from ranker.ui/ directory.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: CQRS (MediatR), record types for commands/queries/DTOs, IEntityTypeConfiguration for EF config, standalone Angular components with ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush and signals.
key_patterns: Backend: Commands/Queries are sealed records implementing IRequest<TResponse>. Handlers use primary-constructor injection. DTOs are sealed records in Dtos/PaymentDtos.cs. EF config is in Data/Configurations/ implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Frontend: All components are standalone. State via Angular signals. Services use inject() and return Observable. Routes are lazy-loaded in app.routes.ts. API_BASE_URL comes from core/config/api-config.ts.
directory_structure: backend/ranker/ — single ASP.NET Core project. Domain/Entities/ = EF entities. Data/ = DbContext + Configurations/. Application/Payments/ = all CQRS payment handlers. Controllers/ = API controllers. Dtos/ = response/request DTOs. Migrations/ = EF migrations. ranker.ui/src/app/ — Angular app. features/ = one folder per page-level component. core/services/ = injectable services. core/models/ = TypeScript interfaces. core/config/ = API URL resolver. app.routes.ts = lazy route registry.
